text:
sam: Heads-up — Nimbus Health asked if we can do a temporary hosted pricing exception. They want per-token price capped at $0.0003 for embeddings once monthly usage > 5M tokens for the POC. They say spikes from batched embeddings push them into mincharge territory.

emily: Context: 3-month POC, estimate ~12M tokens/mo during active periods. They want predictable unit cost otherwise they can't sign the POC.

rohit: We've historically handled mincharge waivers and commit-based tiers, but not a mid-tier per-token breakpoint. Need an econ calc + legal. @devon can ops support a conditional billing override or is that purely finance/legal?

devon: Ops can support a conditional config if finance signs off. Requirements from infra side: batched ingestion only (no streaming), and a soft rate limit to prevent bursts. Example policy snippet we need in the SOW:```
max_batch_tokens: 500000
burst_window_seconds: 600
allow_streaming: false
```

elise: pricing-bot suggests feasible options: a) 3-month pilot cap $0.0003 for tokens >5M with 50% prepay; b) temporary mincharge waiver + monthly capped spend; c) commit-based tier reduction (6mo commit). Which should we propose first? :thinking_face:

sam: Customer won't prepay, so they'd prefer commit (c) or a short-term cap w/no prepay if we can accept some risk. They said 6 months at ~6M tokens/mo might be possible.

rohit: If they commit 6M/mo for 6 months at $0.0003 that's ~$10.8k total. Finance needs margin >=30% and legal sign-off for the temporary clause. I'll run the econ. Also need to know expected token distribution (text vs embeddings) — embeddings cost more on our backend.

devon: Note: embedding-heavy workloads have higher perf impact. If they accept batching constraints and an enforced QPS cap we can reduce risk. Ops asks for explicit throughput limits in the SOW and a fallback to a compatible quantized model if latency breaches SLO.

emily: I'll confirm commit details and ask them to agree to batching + throughput limits. Also looping in legal for contract clause language.

rohit: Creating deal-desk ticket and tagging finance + legal. Ticket created: deal-bot: DD-482 — requesting temporary per-token breakpoint approval (90-day review window). I'll attach econ calc and modeled margin.

sam: Great — customer wants to start next week if we can lock this. Marking priority high :rotating_light:

elise: For the record, if finance rejects the no-prepay cap, fallback is mincharge waiver + usage cap. I'll draft both proposals and post in #deal-desk.

deal-bot: DD-482 created by rohit. Status: awaiting finance review.
